The person behind Ayyanar

About Ayyanar Jewellery.

Our managing director

Yukesh Varma P

Managing Director · Ayyanar Jewellery

A BBA graduate in Retail Management, Yukesh brings a thoughtful eye for the customer experience and an interest in data-led decision-making. He is shaping Ayyanar Jewellery around clear choices, personal service and a more approachable relationship with gold.

His vision is simple: help every customer find a piece worth keeping and a way to make each gold purchase feel considered.

With care, Yukesh
